title: 65_HS1-834228961_62-HQ-83894_Serial_449
doc_notes: This document is an FBI case file containing various newspaper clippings and articles regarding UFO sightings and contactee claims, with encounter content present.

encounters.summary: Gary T. Wilcox reported an encounter with an egg-shaped craft and its occupants on his farm.
encounters.communication_content: The beings spoke in perfect but stilted, smooth English.
physical_effects: no grass growing in landing spot
encounters.quote: I know what I saw. I even talked with them and even joking with them.

encounters.summary: Johnny Sparks, age 11, reported two saucer-shaped objects landing in his driveway.
encounters.entity_behavior: landed like an airplane, top spun
encounters.quote: When it started landing it had legs and put them down.

encounters.summary: Two police officers reported a copper-colored saucer-shaped object landing on a highway.
encounters.entity_behavior: took off silently at great speed
physical_effects: six-foot wide section of road burned
encounters.quote: The shiny copper-colored object resembled a giant spinning top.
